headline: IMF and World Bank annual meetings to kick off in Bangkok; authorities launch work-from-home to ease traffic
summary: The annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank will take place in Bangkok from the 12th to the 18th, with more than 191 countries expected to attend.
why: The IMF and World Bank set global economic policy guidance and lending programmes, and their annual meetings often shape expectations for growth, debt and financing.
